resources.string: Tap the handle for Explain screen and other EQO shortcuts.
Accessibility is off. Turn on EQO in Screen control service to show the handle.
Keep EQO running in the background

Choose EQO and allow background running in battery settings. On ColorOS or Realme, allow Auto-launch and background activity in App battery management. On Xiaomi, allow Autostart and choose No restrictions. On Samsung, remove EQO from Sleeping apps and add it to Never sleeping apps. Names vary by phone; these choices are yours and do not guarantee the phone will keep EQO alive.
Battery settings are not available here. Open Settings → Battery and find EQO.
1. Swipe down twice from the top of the screen.\n2. Tap the pencil or Edit button to open the Quick Settings editor.\n3. Drag Explain screen into your active tiles, then tap Done.
Swipe down twice, then tap the pencil or Edit button. Android does not offer a direct editor link on this phone.
Start with the Edge handle: turn it on in Setup, open another app, tap the handle, then Explain screen. The notification, accessibility button and Quick Settings tile are alternate entries.
